name: Isekai de Nekomimi Seijo to Tsundere Elf
original_name: 異世界で猫耳聖女とツンデレエルフ
source:
The protagonist tries to save a girl from a random attacker but ends up losing his life. Afterward, a god-like being reincarnates him to save another world.

Reborn as Haruki, he meets Philia, a cat-eared saint, at a church, and the two set off on an adventure together. Haruki’s… ahem essence becomes a source of magical power, and the closer he gets to Philia, the stronger her magic grows, leading to rapid development of her skill.

However, Philia must undergo a ritual to become the Great Saint, and Haruki has to part ways with her temporarily. While fighting solo on the battlefield, Haruki one day encounters an elf…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/dlaf/=/link/work/aid/vndb/id/RJ01141121.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
主角试图从随机袭击者手中拯救一个女孩，但最终失去了生命。后来，一位神灵转世拯救了另一个世界。

重生为春树的他在教堂遇见了猫耳圣女菲莉亚，两人一起踏上了冒险之旅。春树的……咳咳本质成为了魔力的源泉，越接近菲莉亚，她的魔力就越强，技能也随之飞速发展。

然而，菲莉亚必须接受成为大圣的仪式，春树不得不暂时与她分道扬镳。春树在战场上单打独斗，有一天遇到了一只精灵……
